steps.label: Liveness check
Precondition: the default fluid block is seeded (0,0,0)-(20,20,20)
Precondition: SSFR is off by default -- the HDR composite runs as a pure passthrough tonemap
Background set + environment + shared light on the fluid camera
Synthetic cube map (SSFR reflections + refraction environment)
Shared directional light
Let the fluid column slump so there is a real surface to reconstruct
A rigid sphere planted inside the fluid volume (occluder / refractor)
Sphere near the shared camera target, overlapping the fluid
A second sphere behind the fluid block
Precondition: floor + 2 spheres
Shade the rigid bodies so they read as solids against the fluid
Turn on screen-space fluid rendering
Change: SSFR reports enabled
Advance so the SSFR surface + rigid occlusion settle
Screenshot: rigid spheres in front of / inside / behind the SSFR fluid surface
Switch SSFR to the thickness/absorption mode
Advance a couple of frames
Screenshot: an alternate SSFR mode composited on the same HDR scene
Back to surface mode
Turn SSFR off -- the HDR scene must still composite (pure ACES passthrough)
Change: SSFR reports disabled
Advance a couple of frames
Screenshot: the glTF background + rigid spheres, no fluid surface, tonemapped once
Invariant: the app is still alive after the SSFR toggles + mode changes + captures
Neg: an out-of-range SSFR mode index is rejected
Neg: a non-boolean SSFR toggle is rejected
